descriptors.statement: Gleaming wheels like beryl, constructed as wheel within wheel, accompany the living creatures, with rims full of eyes all around.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: The mobility and omniscient vigilance of God's throne, which goes in every direction and sees all things

descriptors.statement: The spirit of the living creatures is in the wheels, so that wheels and creatures move and stop in perfect concert.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: The unified, Spirit-directed motion of God's heavenly throne and its attendants
